CHPL’s current welcome page says outdoor book drops at all its libraries accept returns 24 hours a day, and branch drive-through windows operate during regular service hours. It does not give Harrison’s slot height, vehicle clearance or reachable controls.
Book drops, outside all of our libraries, are available to drop off returned materials 24 hours a day.
Several branch libraries have drive-thru windows that are open during regular service hours.
CHPL offers book-club service for its door-to-door and mail customers, with selections tailored to their needs and an emphasis on large print and audiobooks. Contact Outreach to discuss arrangements.
Book club service is available for our door-to-door and mail customers. We tailor our selections to your needs with a focus on large print and audiobooks.
lou-hartfiel-memorial-park: Shelter 2 is to the left when entering from Buttermilk Pike, beside the 9/11 and Kenton County Veterans memorials and near the playground and restrooms. The city lists eight picnic tables, four grills and electricity; toilet layout, changing facilities and the complete route are not described.

Shelter #2 is located to the left when entering the Park from Buttermilk Pike, adjacent to the 9/11 Memorial and the Kenton County Veterans Memorial. It is conveniently located near the playground and restrooms and includes: Eight picnic tables Four grills Electrical service

The city describes Shelter 3, to the right when entering from Buttermilk Pike, as a quieter setting with ten picnic tables, four grills and electricity. This is the city’s description, not a measured sound level or a guarantee of quiet.
Shelter #3 is located to the right when entering the Park from Buttermilk Pike. It offers a quieter setting and includes: Ten picnic tables Four grills Electrical service
The park rules, revised January 29, 2026, prohibit music and amplified sound in Shelter 3. They do not establish that surrounding activity will be quiet.
Music and amplified sound are prohibited in Shelter #3.

Shelters 2 and 3 are available to rent April–October and closed November–March. The rental page does not say this seasonal closure applies to the park’s restrooms; confirm toilet availability separately.
Shelters #2 and #3 are available for rental April through October and are closed November through March.
Shelter 1 cannot be rented and remains available for community use on a first-come, first-served basis. A table or shelter space is not guaranteed.
Shelter #1 is not available for rental and remains open for community use on a first-come, first-served basis.

Shelter reservations open at 12:01 a.m. on February 1 each year, first come, first served. Submitting the request form does not finalize a booking: a city representative must confirm availability, and full payment secures the date.

Reservations open at 12:01 a.m. on February 1 each year and are accepted on a first-come, first-served basis. Please complete the form below to request your preferred date. A City representative will contact you to confirm availability. Reservations are not finalized until confirmed, and full payment is required to secure the date.

The January 29, 2026 park rules set daily hours of 8 a.m.–9 p.m., with no people or vehicles permitted outside those hours. Parking is limited to designated areas; vehicles are prohibited on grass or landscaped areas.
The park is open daily from 8:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m.
No persons or vehicles are permitted in the park outside of these hours.
Parking is allowed only in designated parking areas. Vehicles are not permitted on grass or landscaped areas.

The shelter rules prohibit extension cords and power strips. If you depend on powered equipment, confirm the electrical arrangement you need; listed electricity does not establish a usable charging setup.
Extension cords and power strips are not permitted.

The January 29, 2026 shelter rules allow a full refund for cancellations at least 30 days ahead; cancellations within 30 days and inclement weather do not receive refunds. Date changes must be requested more than seven days ahead, depend on availability and carry a $10 fee.
Cancellations made at least 30 days in advance are eligible for a full refund.
No refunds are issued due to inclement weather.
Date changes must be requested more than 7 days in advance, are subject to availability, and include a $10 handling fee.
